pages.text: The first session plays much like vanilla. Gather wood, make stone tools, eat, and get walls and a light source up before dark.

Things that are new near most spawns:$(li)Deer, rabbits, birds and butterflies are harmless.$(li)Boars, bears and snakes fight back if hit. Leave bear cubs alone.$(li)Fishing and hunting give more food: venison, bushmeat and fish.

Nights work as in vanilla. A $(l:systems/camping)sleeping bag$(/l) (Comforts) lets you sleep through the night anywhere without moving your spawn point, which is ideal for trips. A hammock lets you rest through the day instead.
pages.title: Before Nightfall

pages.text: Keep a torch in your off-hand when exploring: with shaders on it lights your surroundings. Your minimap (top left) shows terrain as you uncover it.

Large stone ruins, skeletal fortresses and anything with a boss bar are late-game. The $(l:getting_started/danger)danger guide$(/l) lists what to expect where.$(br2)Caves are ordinary near the surface. The deep layer (deepslate, below height 0) is where cave brutes such as the $(l:wild_monsters/bluff)Bluff$(/l) hunt.
